name: Requires Authenticator
description: A policy rule requires, or accepts, an authenticator to satisfy its verification. The properties carry the constraint that makes the difference between 'MFA' and 'phishing-resistant MFA'.

constraint.description: Which factor class the authenticator satisfies in this rule.

phishing_resistant.description: The rule demands a phishing-resistant method of this class.

hardware_protected.description: The rule demands a hardware-protected key (device-bound).
